fetch.description: A Model Context Protocol server that provides web content fetching capabilities. This server enables LLMs to retrieve and process content from web pages, converting HTML to markdown for easier consumption.

git.description: A Model Context Protocol server for Git repository interaction and automation. This server provides tools to read, search, and manipulate Git repositories via Large Language Models.

memory.description: A persistent memory using a local knowledge graph. This lets LLM remember information about the user across chats.

sequential-thinking.description: An MCP that provides a tool for dynamic and reflective problem-solving through a structured thinking process.

news_mcp.description: A MCP server that provides news fetching capabilities. This server enables LLMs to retrieve and process news content from various sources, converting it into a format suitable for analysis and consumption.
